_about: Recorded sound effects for the explainer sound design. Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (checked 2026-10-03 at mixkit.co/license/modal/sfxFree/): commercial use in videos allowed, no credit needed, but the files may not be passed on by themselves, so they are not in git: audio.py downloads them into video/.cache/sfx on first use. In a timeline fx entry: {"t": seconds, "sfx": "id", "db": level vs the voice, "align": "onset|peak|end|start", "reverse": bool, "max": seconds, "pan": -1..1}.
